rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both letters transmit Labor-backed draft legislation for employment training, justify it through the need to make productive use of national manpower, describe equipping people with occupational skills, refer readers to an enclosed Secretary of Labor letter and explanatory memorandum, and note the parallel letter to the other chamber. C12 shares the child's youth-focused pilot or demonstration approach and local-community emphasis, but its wording and overall letter structure are less close. C09 also concerns a pilot program, training, service, and skilled manpower, but lacks C16's concentrated verbal and administrative parallels.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith a draft bill to provide useful employment and training on a pilot basis
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith a draft of a bill designed to carry out the recommendation ... providing for the training and retraining
shared_material.explanation: Both open by transmitting draft legislation centered on employment training.

shared_material.child_excerpt: assisting our young people in acquiring the skills necessary for productive employment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: must be equipped with new skills enabling them to become productive members of our society once again
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel formulation links acquiring new skills with becoming productive workers or members of society.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The progress we make as a Nation depends upon the use we make of our resources, including manpower.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: achieving full use of our resources, as well as in meeting the occupational demands of our Nation
shared_material.explanation: Both justify the legislation as necessary for fuller national use of human resources.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the enclosed letter to me from the Secretary of Labor and the accompanying memorandum
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Also enclosed is a letter sent me by the Secretary of Labor ... and a memorandum explaining the draft bill in detail.
shared_material.explanation: The same supporting-document package is described in closely parallel language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A letter similar to this is being sent to the Speaker of the House (President of the Senate).
shared_material.parent_excerpt: A similar letter is being sent the Speaker of the House of Representatives.
shared_material.explanation: Both close by noting the corresponding transmission to the other congressional chamber.
